prerequisite: Both expanded SFT arms verified; all four models have audited full development and test results; development choice already frozen
evidence: Complete original evidence and full numeric fact catalogue, exactly messages_for used at inference; no reference-selected rows or fact IDs. Select fitting training prompts only and report exclusions.
reward: 1 only for a valid source-bound tool execution matching the released training answer; 0 otherwise
pair_rule: First complete reward-1 and reward-0 outputs in fixed seed order; preserve every generation and exclusion; no synthetic wrong answers
reference: Frozen development-selected SFT model, native BF16 base and FP32 LoRA; precompute summed assistant-only log probabilities with caching disabled
selection: No hyperparameter search. Apply predeclared SFT development quality, capability and latency gates against the reference, then report the full frozen test comparison
limits: Execution agreement is an automatic training reward, not human financial preference or verified financial interpretation. Length-filtered preference subset is reported separately from the 2003-example SFT set.
revision: full-context-v2, before any preference sampling or optimization
length_validation: Full context at the old 1280 prompt cap retained only 42/2003 eligible source traces. Raise prompt/pair limits to 1792/2048 before sampling; actual longest-pair forward/backward and full-state recovery required before remaining updates.
